answer: The kernel holds work receipts rather than names, so the spiral of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Reaching the ember of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, rewards vest against future work.
